title: Addendum 2: confirm that network-burst rate, not firing rate, is the early chip sentinel (SIMULATED)
status: registered after the FlyWire sweep, before the FlyWire confirmation runs and before any MaleCNS result was read
seen_before_registration: all results of the registered FlyWire sweep (seeds 100+, 300+), including C2 failing in every family
exploratory: of the six chip features, network_burst_rate_per_min reaches |delta log2| >= 0.5 at or before the first behaviour-impairment dose in all five families; mfr_hz does so in none
the MaleCNS replication was running when this was registered; none of its output had been read
why_this_needs_confirmation: network_burst_rate_per_min was picked as the best of six features after seeing the data; a feature chosen that way can win by chance

design.flywire_confirmation: the parent design unchanged, with fresh seeds: spontaneous 700+ (3 seeds, 10 s), behaviour 800+ (8 trials); no evoked or replication runs
design.malecns: the MaleCNS replication as registered in fly_malecns_replication.json, its output as written
design.detection: first dose with |delta log2 feature| >= 0.5; impairment: first dose with disruption index >= 0.5 (parent definition)

N1_network_bursts_are_an_early_sentinel_.statement: On fresh seeds, network-burst rate detects at or before behavioural impairment
N1_network_bursts_are_an_early_sentinel_.test: in all five families with any impairment: first network_burst dose <= first behaviour dose

N2_firing_rate_lags_flywire.statement: On fresh seeds, the C2 failure replicates: firing rate detects after behaviour
N2_firing_rate_lags_flywire.test: first mfr dose > first behaviour dose in at least 4 of the families with any impairment

N3_network_bursts_are_an_early_sentinel_.statement: In the male CNS, network-burst rate detects at or before behavioural impairment
N3_network_bursts_are_an_early_sentinel_.test: first network_burst dose <= first behaviour dose in at least 4 of the families with any impairment; reported as uninterpretable if MaleCNS M0 fails

N4_firing_rate_lags_malecns.statement: In the male CNS, firing rate detects after behaviour
N4_firing_rate_lags_malecns.test: first mfr dose > first behaviour dose in at least 4 of the families with any impairment; uninterpretable if M0 fails

reporting: All four reported with values and pass/fail, whichever way they fall.
